class.name: SceneCatalog
class.brief_description: Project-wide registry of every travellable scene.
class.description: A [SceneCatalog] is the "cell list" for [SceneManager]: it maps a stable string id to a scene file path plus metadata. [SceneDoor] and [method SceneManager.travel_to] always refer to a scene by its id, never by raw path, so scenes can be moved on disk without editing every door. Keep one [code].tres[/code] under version control and hand it to the manager with [method SceneManager.set_catalog] or [method SceneManager.set_catalog_path]. The [b]Scenes[/b] editor dock (bottom panel) edits it visually.

method.description: Removes the first entry with this id.
